column1: # Which template becomes which file, relative to the tree it is generated into.
# Two kinds of row.
# THEME-OWNED files hold only colours and are regenerated on every theme
# change. Nothing a user would edit lives in them.
# USER-OWNED files carry structure - keybinds, layout, sizes - and are seeded
# once and then never touched again. They are rendered rather than copied for
# one reason: foot and fuzzel document `include` as taking an absolute path, so
# the include line has to carry the real home directory.
# <template>
column2: <destination, relative to the tree it lands in>

column1: # Destinations carry no .config/ prefix, because the two trees they are
# rendered into are rooted differently: ~/.config for the colour files, and
# /usr/share/archwright/default-config - which is already laid out relative
# to ~/.config - for the seeded ones. The caller supplies the root.
